description: This file defines the DeletedFragment class, a UI component for displaying and managing deleted notes in an Android app. It handles menu actions, navigation, and UI updates related to deleted notes.

classes.name: DeletedFragment
classes.description: A fragment class managing the UI for displaying deleted notes, including menu actions, navigation, and dialog interactions.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu for the fragment, adding options specific to deleted notes.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections such as emptying the bin, showing hidden notes, selecting all notes, and navigating to search.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Updates UI elements based on the data, particularly the deletion time indicator.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles click events on notes, navigating to the editor with animation.

methods.name: onNoteLongClick
methods.description: Handles long click events on notes, showing a menu for note actions.

methods.name: showEmptyBinDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog for permanently deleting all notes in the bin.
